wishes: Planner defaults (Pavel gave only the genre and title): enchanted, whimsical garden of classic public-domain fairy tales; magical glow and sparkle but bright and warm, never dark or scary; generic forms only (no film-specific designs); no characters, no text.

variants.concept: Enchanted Garden: magic plants and fairy homes

cards.name: Magic Wand
cards.subject: a slim white magic wand with a golden star tip, tilted, with a small trail of sparkles
cards.unique_detail: a tiny pink ribbon tied below the star
cards.background: rich purple with concentric rings centred behind the wand
cards.why: The fairy godmother's tool; instantly reads as magic.

cards.name: Fairy Lantern
cards.subject: a small brass garden lantern with a warm glowing light inside, standing on a mossy garden stone
cards.unique_detail: a tiny flower vine curling around the handle
cards.main_colors: brass, warm yellow glow, green moss
cards.background: a mossy stone ledge in front of a smooth warm orange wall
cards.why: Lights the way through the enchanted garden.

cards.name: Toadstool House
cards.subject: a cosy cottage shaped like a big red-capped toadstool with white spots, a round wooden door and little windows
cards.unique_detail: a tiny lantern hanging beside the door
cards.main_colors: red cap with white spots, cream stem, brown door
cards.background: a strip of green garden grass with a few flowers at the bottom and a bright blue sky with soft clouds
cards.why: The classic fairy-tale home.

cards.name: Magic Beans
cards.subject: a small open burlap pouch spilling three glowing green magic beans
cards.unique_detail: a soft golden glow around the beans
cards.background: a plain warm pink surface in front of a smooth pink gradient wall
cards.why: The beans that grow the giant beanstalk.

cards.name: Golden Apple
cards.subject: a shiny golden apple with a green leaf on its stem
cards.unique_detail: a small sparkle glinting on its side
cards.background: warm red with radiating rays
cards.why: The golden apple of the old tales.

cards.name: Beanstalk
cards.subject: a giant twisting green beanstalk with big leaves, rising up into the clouds
cards.unique_detail: a few little golden beans hanging among the leaves
cards.background: a strip of garden at the bottom and a bright blue sky with soft clouds
cards.why: Jack's climb to the clouds.

cards.name: Spinning Wheel
cards.subject: an old wooden spinning wheel with a spool of golden thread
cards.unique_detail: the golden thread glowing softly
cards.background: a polished wooden floor in front of a smooth purple wall
cards.why: Straw spun into gold; the sleeping-castle tale.

cards.name: Crystal Ball
cards.subject: a clear crystal ball on a small golden stand, with a soft swirl of pink light inside
cards.unique_detail: a tiny star twinkling inside the ball
cards.main_colors: clear glass, pink glow, gold stand
cards.background: sunny yellow with radiating rays
cards.why: Seeing the future, a fairy-tale staple.

cards.name: Pocket Watch
cards.subject: an open golden pocket watch with a chain
cards.unique_detail: tiny hearts in place of the numbers on its face
cards.background: a plain green surface in front of a smooth green gradient wall
cards.why: Always late for something; a nod to Wonderland.

cards.name: Wishing Well
cards.subject: a round stone wishing well with a little red tiled roof and a wooden bucket
cards.unique_detail: flowers growing along its stone rim
cards.background: a strip of green garden at the bottom and a bright blue sky with soft clouds
cards.why: Make a wish in the fairy-tale garden.

variants.concept: Royal Tale: the castle, the crown and the royal treasures

cards.name: Golden Crown
cards.subject: a golden royal crown set with red and blue jewels, tilted
cards.unique_detail: a small heart-shaped ruby at the front
cards.main_colors: warm gold, red and blue gems
cards.background: warm red with radiating rays
cards.why: Royalty is at the heart of the fairy tale.

cards.name: Magic Mirror
cards.subject: an ornate oval golden mirror on a stand, its glass glowing with a soft blue shimmer
cards.unique_detail: a little golden rose at the top of the frame
cards.background: a polished stone castle floor in front of a smooth purple wall
cards.why: Mirror, mirror on the wall.

cards.name: Tower Braid
cards.subject: a round stone castle tower with a pointed blue roof and a long golden braid of hair hanging from its only window
cards.unique_detail: a pink flower woven into the braid
cards.main_colors: cream stone, blue roof, golden braid
cards.background: a strip of green meadow at the bottom and a bright blue sky with soft clouds
cards.why: The tower with the long golden braid.

cards.name: Enchanted Apple
cards.subject: a single shiny red apple
cards.unique_detail: a tiny sparkle of magic above the stem
cards.background: a plain green surface in front of a smooth green gradient wall
cards.why: The apple from the forest tale.

cards.name: Golden Key
cards.subject: an ornate golden key with a swirly bow
cards.unique_detail: a small heart cut into the bow
cards.background: rich purple with concentric rings centred behind the key
cards.why: The key to the secret garden door.

cards.name: Pumpkin Coach
cards.subject: a round orange pumpkin coach with golden wheels and curly golden trim
cards.unique_detail: a little heart-shaped window in the door
cards.background: a strip of garden path at the bottom and a bright blue sky with soft clouds
cards.why: The magic carriage to the ball.

cards.name: Golden Harp
cards.subject: a small golden harp with curved frame and strings
cards.unique_detail: a carved swan-neck tip at the top
cards.background: a polished marble floor in front of a smooth warm pink wall
cards.why: The singing harp from the giant's castle.

cards.name: Potion Bottle
cards.subject: a heart-shaped glass potion bottle with a cork, filled with glowing pink liquid
cards.unique_detail: a little golden tag (blank) tied to the neck
cards.background: sunny yellow with radiating rays
cards.why: A love potion, or a cure for a spell.

cards.name: Golden Egg
cards.subject: a shiny golden egg resting in a straw nest
cards.unique_detail: a single white feather in the nest
cards.background: a plain warm red surface in front of a smooth red gradient wall
cards.why: The goose that laid the golden egg.

cards.name: Gingerbread House
cards.subject: a gingerbread cottage with a thick white icing roof and colourful candy decorations
cards.unique_detail: a candy-cane door frame
cards.main_colors: warm brown gingerbread, white icing, colourful candy
cards.background: a strip of green meadow at the bottom and a bright blue sky with soft clouds
cards.why: The sweet cottage in the forest.

variants.concept: Wonderland Tea Party: the topsy-turvy garden party

cards.name: Top Hat
cards.subject: a tall green top hat with an orange ribbon band, tilted
cards.unique_detail: a small blank card tucked into the band
cards.background: sunny yellow with radiating rays
cards.why: The famous hat from the mad tea party.

cards.name: Flower Teapot
cards.subject: a round pink porcelain teapot painted with roses, on a little tea table
cards.unique_detail: a rose-shaped knob on the lid
cards.background: a lace-covered tea table in front of a smooth purple wall
cards.why: Tea time that never ends.

cards.name: Hedge Maze
cards.subject: the entrance of a green hedge maze with a heart-shaped arch cut into the hedge
cards.unique_detail: red roses growing on the arch
cards.background: a strip of garden path at the bottom and a bright blue sky with soft clouds
cards.why: The queen's garden labyrinth.

cards.name: Croquet Set
cards.subject: a wooden croquet mallet leaning on a bright pink croquet ball
cards.unique_detail: a little heart painted on the ball
cards.background: a plain green surface in front of a smooth green gradient wall
cards.why: The royal croquet game.

cards.name: Rabbit Watch
cards.subject: a golden pocket watch on a chain, swinging and tilted
cards.unique_detail: a small pair of bunny ears on top of the watch case
cards.background: warm red with radiating rays
cards.why: Late, late for a very important date.

cards.name: Tea Party Table
cards.subject: a long garden table set with mismatched teapots, teacups and cakes under a tree
cards.unique_detail: a tall tiered cake stand in the middle
cards.background: a strip of garden lawn at the bottom and a bright blue sky with soft clouds
cards.why: The mad tea party itself.

cards.name: Tiny Door
cards.subject: a tiny round wooden door with a golden knob set into the base of a tree trunk
cards.unique_detail: a little heart-shaped window in the door
cards.main_colors: warm brown wood, red door, gold knob
cards.background: a mossy garden ground in front of a smooth warm orange wall
cards.why: The tiny door into Wonderland.

cards.name: Paint the Roses
cards.subject: a paintbrush dripping red paint over a white rose
cards.unique_detail: the rose half painted red
cards.main_colors: red paint, white rose, wooden brush
cards.background: rich purple with concentric rings centred behind the brush
cards.why: Painting the roses red.

cards.name: Jam Tarts
cards.subject: a plate of four heart-shaped jam tarts
cards.unique_detail: a sprinkle of powdered sugar on top
cards.background: a plain sunny yellow surface in front of a smooth yellow gradient wall
cards.why: The queen's stolen tarts.

cards.name: Teapot House
cards.subject: a cosy cottage shaped like a giant pink teapot, with a spout chimney and a round door
cards.unique_detail: the teapot lid as a domed roof with a golden knob
cards.background: a strip of green garden at the bottom and a bright blue sky with soft clouds
cards.why: Topsy-turvy Wonderland architecture.
